title: IntraGuard: Committee-Side Defenses Against Review Outsourcing to Commercial Chatbots
abstract: arXiv:2605.05271v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs become increasingly capable, editorial boards and program committees are growing concerned about reviewers who fully outsource peer review to commercial chatbots. This concern stems from prior findings that current chatbots lack the independent critical thinking and depth of reasoning required to assess scientific novelty. One promising direction for mitigating this concern is to embed hidden instructions into manuscripts that disrupt or alter chatbot-generated reviews. However, existing methods remain intuitive and fragile, as they typically rely on homogeneous payloads injected in an inter-stream manner, rendering them susceptible to sanitization or neutralization. More broadly, the community still lacks a systematic formulation of this threat and a principled defense framework. translated_title: IntraGuard：针对同行评审外包给商业聊天机器人的委员会侧防御
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的能力日益增强，编辑委员会和程序委员会越来越担心审稿人将同行评审完全外包给商业聊天机器人。这种担忧源于先前的研究发现：当前的聊天机器人缺乏评估科学创新性所需的独立批判性思维和深度推理能力。缓解这一担忧的一个有前景的方向是在稿件中嵌入隐藏指令，以干扰或改变聊天机器人生成的评审意见。然而，现有方法仍然直观且脆弱，因为它们通常依赖于以流间方式注入的同质化载荷，使其容易被清除或中和。更广泛地说，学界目前仍缺乏对这一威胁的系统性表述以及一个有原则的防御框架。在本文中，我们识别出端到端评审外包作为一种新兴威胁，并提出了 IntraGuard——一个黑盒、与发表会议无关的防御框架。
tldr: 该论文首次将审稿人将同行评审端到端外包给商业聊天机器人的行为识别为新兴威胁，并提出了 IntraGuard——一个黑盒、与发表会议无关的委员会侧防御框架。
